audit_metadata.scope: README.md, all module docstrings, examples/, docs/, __init__.py files, deployment guides, tutorials, API references
audit_metadata.correction_note: Cluster 9 reported several files as missing that actually exist (LICENSE, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, Makefile, .github/workflows/ci.yml, examples/quickstart.py, docs/deployment.md). This v2 report corrects those false positives and identifies only genuine remaining gaps.

gaps.title: 9 of 11 __init__.py files are empty
gaps.description: Only src/integration/__init__.py and src/onboarding/__init__.py have docstrings. The remaining 9 (src/__init__.py, src/decision_support/, src/digital_twin/, src/genomics/, src/iot/, src/multi_agent/, src/optimization/, src/path_planning/, tests/__init__.py) are completely empty — no module docstring, no re-exports, no __all__.
gaps.impact: No package-level documentation; IDEs cannot show package help; no public API surface definition; users must discover classes by reading source.
gaps.recommendation: Add module docstrings to each __init__.py describing the package purpose. Re-export key classes for convenient imports. Define __all__ for explicit public API.

gaps.title: docs/deployment.md is minimal (35 lines)
gaps.description: The deployment guide is only 563 bytes / 35 lines. It shows basic docker build/run and kubectl apply commands but the referenced k8s/ directory does not exist. No environment variable documentation, no health check endpoints, no rollback procedures, no monitoring setup, no SSL/TLS configuration.
gaps.impact: Users cannot actually deploy to production. The kubectl commands reference non-existent manifests. No guidance for edge deployment (Jetson/Raspberry Pi).
gaps.recommendation: Expand deployment.md to 200+ lines with: environment variables table, health check endpoints, resource requirements, scaling guidance, monitoring/observability setup, SSL/TLS configuration, rollback procedures. Create k8s/ directory with actual manifests (deployment.yaml, service.yaml, configmap.yaml, hpa.yaml). Add edge deployment guide for Jetson/Raspberry Pi.

gaps.title: Only 1 example file for 18+ modules
gaps.description: examples/ contains only quickstart.py (2314 bytes) which covers 5 of 18 modules (TSP, VRP, sensor placement, digital twin, decision support). No examples for: swarm coordination, consensus, task allocation, IoT pipeline, context broker, smart models, data validation, knowledge graph, ontology, API gateway, security, GPS anti-spoofing, edge AI, crop vision, genomics (CRISPR/protein), path planning, collision avoidance, fault tolerance, unified optimizer, event bus, farm state, onboarding.
gaps.impact: Users must read source code to understand usage patterns for 13+ modules. High onboarding friction.
gaps.recommendation: Create examples/ with: basic_tsp.py, basic_vrp.py, swarm_coordination.py, byzantine_consensus.py, task_allocation.py, iot_pipeline.py, context_broker_demo.py, digital_twin_sim.py, knowledge_graph_demo.py, ontology_demo.py, decision_support.py, api_gateway_demo.py, security_demo.py, gps_antispoof_demo.py, edge_ai_demo.py, crop_vision_demo.py, crispr_demo.py, protein_demo.py, path_planning_demo.py, collision_avoidance.py, fault_tolerance_demo.py, unified_optimizer_demo.py, event_bus_demo.py, onboarding_demo.py, end_to_end_farm.py.

gaps.title: No tutorials
gaps.description: No step-by-step tutorials exist for any workflow. Users cannot learn how to: deploy a digital twin, set up an IoT pipeline, design CRISPR guides, configure swarm coordination, or integrate modules end-to-end.
gaps.impact: Users cannot learn workflows; only API-level snippets available in README.
gaps.recommendation: Create tutorials/ with: 01-getting-started.md, 02-optimization-basics.md, 03-swarm-coordination.md, 04-iot-data-pipeline.md, 05-digital-twin-simulation.md, 06-decision-support.md, 07-api-gateway.md, 08-genomics.md, 09-end-to-end-farm.md, 10-deployment.md.

gaps.title: No API reference documentation
gaps.description: No comprehensive API reference exists for the Python library. The FastAPI app has auto-generated docs at /docs but there is no documentation for the Python classes, methods, dataclasses, parameters, and return types. Users must read source code to understand the API.
gaps.impact: No searchable reference; IDE tooltips incomplete; high barrier for new users.
gaps.recommendation: Generate API docs with pdoc, Sphinx autodoc, or mkdocstrings. Document all public classes, methods, dataclasses, and their parameters/returns.

gaps.title: No CONTRIBUTING.md
gaps.description: No contribution guidelines exist. New contributors have no guidance on code style, PR process, or development setup.
gaps.impact: Barrier to external contributions; inconsistent code quality from lack of standards.
gaps.recommendation: Add CONTRIBUTING.md covering: dev environment setup, code style (ruff formatter/linter), PR process, commit message conventions, testing requirements.

gaps.title: No SECURITY.md
gaps.description: No security policy exists. The project has a security module (JWT, RBAC, rate limiting, GPS anti-spoofing) but no documented security reporting process.
gaps.impact: Security vulnerabilities have no disclosure channel; users don't know how to report issues.
gaps.recommendation: Add SECURITY.md with supported versions, reporting process, and scope (aligned with the zero-trust architecture).

gaps.title: No CHANGELOG.md
gaps.description: No changelog exists. Users cannot track what changed between versions.
gaps.impact: Poor maintainability; users cannot assess upgrade risk.
gaps.recommendation: Add CHANGELOG.md following Keep a Changelog format. Document the initial release.

gaps.title: No CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
gaps.description: No code of conduct exists for the community.
gaps.impact: Missing community standards; less welcoming to new contributors.
gaps.recommendation: Adopt the Contributor Covenant v2.1 as CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.

gaps.title: No .env.example
gaps.description: No example environment file. The project uses secrets (JWT secret, database passwords) but documents no environment variable conventions.
gaps.impact: Users don't know what env vars are needed; risk of committing secrets.
gaps.recommendation: Add .env.example with: JWT_SECRET, DATABASE_URL, MQTT_BROKER_URL, KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS, TIMESCALEDB_URL, API_PORT, LOG_LEVEL, AGTECH_ENV.

gaps.title: No PR template or issue templates
gaps.description: No .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md or .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ directory exists.
gaps.impact: Inconsistent PR/issue quality; missing context in submissions.
gaps.recommendation: Add PR template (description, testing, checklist) and issue templates (bug report, feature request, documentation).

gaps.title: No architecture decision records (ADRs)
gaps.description: No docs/adr/ directory. Key architectural choices (in-memory vs. real backends, PBFT consensus approach, NGSI-LD integration) are undocumented.
gaps.impact: Lost design context; future maintainers don't know why decisions were made.
gaps.recommendation: Create docs/adr/ with: 0001-in-memory-backends.md, 0002-pbft-consensus-simulation.md, 0003-ngsi-ld-integration.md, 0004-fastapi-for-api-gateway.md, 0005-pytorch-for-gpu-optimization.md.

gaps.title: No testing guide
gaps.description: README shows basic pytest commands but no comprehensive testing guide (test organization, fixtures, mocking strategy, coverage goals, E2E testing).
gaps.impact: New contributors don't know how to write tests; inconsistent test quality.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/testing.md covering: test structure, running tests, writing unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests, coverage requirements, mocking external services.

gaps.title: No performance tuning guide
gaps.description: No documentation on performance characteristics, benchmarking, or tuning. The project has GPU acceleration and performance tests but no guide.
gaps.impact: Users cannot optimize deployments; no baseline performance data documented.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/performance.md with: benchmark methodology, baseline results, GPU vs. CPU comparison, tuning parameters.

gaps.title: No troubleshooting guide
gaps.description: No FAQ or troubleshooting documentation. Common issues (GPU not found, ONNX model loading failures, MQTT connection problems) are undocumented.
gaps.impact: Users struggle with common issues; increased support burden.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/troubleshooting.md and docs/faq.md with common issues and solutions.

gaps.title: No glossary
gaps.description: No glossary of agricultural and technical terms. The domain uses specialized vocabulary (AGROVOC, NGSI-LD, PBFT, boustrophedon, PAM site, etc.).
gaps.impact: Barrier for users unfamiliar with agricultural or distributed systems terminology.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/glossary.md with terms: AGROVOC, NGSI-LD, PBFT, TSP, VRP, CPP, MRTA, MAPF, PAM, CRISPR, boustrophedon, Christofides, Clarke-Wright, etc.

gaps.title: No code style guide
gaps.description: No documented code style conventions. The codebase uses type hints and docstrings but there's no formal style guide or enforced linter config beyond ruff.
gaps.impact: Inconsistent code style; review friction.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/style-guide.md and configure ruff/mypy in pyproject.toml. Document naming conventions, docstring format, type hint requirements.

gaps.title: No onboarding guide for new developers
gaps.description: No developer onboarding documentation. New team members have no guided path to understand the codebase.
gaps.impact: Slow ramp-up for new developers.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/onboarding.md with: codebase tour, key concepts, first tasks, development workflow, where to get help.

gaps.title: No data flow documentation beyond README diagrams
gaps.description: README has Mermaid diagrams but no detailed data flow documentation (schema definitions, event formats, API contracts).
gaps.impact: Integration partners lack interface specifications.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/data-flows.md with: MQTT topic schema, Kafka message format, NGSI-LD entity schemas, API request/response examples, WebSocket message format.

gaps.title: No k8s/ manifests
gaps.description: docs/deployment.md references 'kubectl apply -f k8s/deployment.yaml' and 'k8s/service.yaml' but the k8s/ directory does not exist.
gaps.impact: Deployment guide is broken; users cannot deploy to Kubernetes.
gaps.recommendation: Create k8s/ directory with: deployment.yaml, service.yaml, configmap.yaml, hpa.yaml, ingress.yaml.

gaps.title: No py.typed marker
gaps.description: The project uses type hints but has no py.typed marker file, so type checkers won't use the inline types for external consumers.
gaps.impact: Type information not available to downstream users.
gaps.recommendation: Add py.typed marker file to src/ and configure pyproject.toml to include it in package data.

gaps.title: No OpenAPI/Swagger spec export
gaps.description: The FastAPI app generates /docs but there's no exported OpenAPI spec file for API consumers.
gaps.impact: API consumers cannot generate client SDKs.
gaps.recommendation: Add a script to export OpenAPI spec to docs/openapi.json. Document how to generate client SDKs.

gaps.title: Missing method docstrings in optimization module
gaps.description: Several public methods lack full docstrings: TSPSolver.__init__, TSPSolver.solve, VRPSolver.__init__, VRPSolver.solve, GPUTSPSolver.__init__, GPUTSPSolver.solve, GPUVRPSolver.__init__, GPUVRPSolver.solve, CoveragePlanner.__init__, CoveragePlanner.plan.
gaps.impact: IDE tooltips and generated docs are incomplete.
gaps.recommendation: Add Google-style docstrings with Args, Returns, Raises sections to all public methods.

gaps.title: Missing method docstrings in multi_agent module
gaps.description: SwarmCoordinator.__init__ has docstring but many methods lack full documentation. ByzantineConsensus.propose and tally_votes have minimal docstrings. TaskAllocator methods lack parameter documentation.
gaps.impact: Incomplete API documentation for swarm coordination.
gaps.recommendation: Add comprehensive docstrings to all public methods with examples.

gaps.title: Missing method docstrings in iot module
gaps.description: MQTTClient, KafkaStream, and TimescaleDBStorage have class docstrings but many public methods lack parameter/return documentation. NGSILDBroker methods have minimal docstrings.
gaps.impact: IoT module API is poorly documented for external users.
gaps.recommendation: Add docstrings to all public methods with type information and examples.

gaps.title: Missing method docstrings in digital_twin module
gaps.description: DigitalTwin.__init__ and simulate have docstrings but _step, _temp_factor, _water_factor lack them. AgriKnowledgeGraph methods have minimal docstrings. AGROVOCOntology methods lack parameter docs.
gaps.impact: Digital twin and knowledge graph APIs are under-documented.
gaps.recommendation: Add docstrings to all public methods, especially query methods and serialization.

gaps.title: Missing method docstrings in decision_support module
gaps.description: DecisionEngine.recommend has docstring but FarmDashboard, AlertManager, APIGateway, ZeroTrustAuth, GPSSpoofingDetector methods lack comprehensive documentation.
gaps.impact: Decision support and security APIs are poorly documented.
gaps.recommendation: Add docstrings to all public methods with security considerations noted.

gaps.title: Missing method docstrings in genomics module
gaps.description: CRISPRDesigner and ProteinAnalyzer have class docstrings but methods lack parameter documentation and examples.
gaps.impact: Genomics module is hard to use without reading source.
gaps.recommendation: Add docstrings with biological context and usage examples.

gaps.title: README Quick Start covers only 1 of 18 modules
gaps.description: Quick Start shows only TSP usage. No examples for VRP, swarm, IoT, digital twin, decision support, API gateway, or genomics. No end-to-end example.
gaps.impact: Users only learn about 1 of 18 modules from the Quick Start.
gaps.recommendation: Expand Quick Start with a 'Module Examples' section showing basic usage for each module. Add an end-to-end farm simulation example.

gaps.title: README Security section lacks usage examples
gaps.description: Security section lists features (JWT, RBAC, rate limiting, GPS anti-spoofing) but shows no code examples of how to use ZeroTrustAuth or GPSSpoofingDetector.
gaps.impact: Users cannot implement security without reading source code.
gaps.recommendation: Add code examples for: generating/validating JWT tokens, checking roles, rate limiting, GPS spoofing detection.

gaps.title: README lacks community/support section
gaps.description: No links to community channels, support, or discussion forums.
gaps.impact: Users don't know where to get help.
gaps.recommendation: Add a Community section with: Discord/Slack link, GitHub Discussions, Stack Overflow tag, email contact.

gaps.title: README lacks badges
gaps.description: No CI status, coverage, PyPI version, or license badges.
gaps.impact: Reduced discoverability and trust.
gaps.recommendation: Add badges: CI status, code coverage, PyPI version, license, Python versions.

tsp.py.notes: Good class docstrings, minimal method docs

recommendations_priority: 1. Populate all 9 empty __init__.py files with docstrings and re-exports
2. Expand docs/deployment.md from 35 lines to comprehensive guide; create k8s/ manifests
3. Create examples/ for all 18+ modules (currently only 1 example)
9. Add tutorials/ with step-by-step guides for all major workflows
18. Add py.typed marker for type information
